summary: Design and review neural population decoding, fMRI MVPA, representational similarity analysis, temporal generalization, searchlight analysis, and encoding models with leakage-safe cross-validation, permutation inference, and neuroscience-specific interpretation safeguards.
use_when: perform fMRI MVPA or neural decoding
perform searchlight decoding or encoding modeling
test decoding accuracy with permutation inference
avoid_when: Cross-validation splits would leak subjects, runs, trials, or preprocessing information
The sample size or label balance cannot support the proposed model
Above-chance prediction would be interpreted as a unique neural mechanism without appropriate controls
